## Summary
- Make the dispatch prompt prioritize the live mention over target issue/PR context when deciding whether work is authorized.
- Default planning, diagnosis, investigation, and check/look-into wording to `answer` unless the mention clearly asks for changes.
- Add few-shot routing examples for `let's think`, `shall we figure out`, and `check and update the OpenAI API`.

## Verification
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/triage.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #362

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #371 closes https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/362 by tightening the dispatch triage prompt for discussion-shaped mentions. The change makes the live mention authoritative over an implementable issue body, so planning, diagnosis, “let’s think,” and similar wording default to `answer`. It also adds the requested few-shot examples for discussion intent and the concrete “check and update” case. The requester explicitly narrowed the work to plan items 1 and 2, leaving regression fixtures, deterministic guards, and model tuning out of scope.

## Review
The reviewers agree the PR is surgical, correctly scoped, and matches the issue discussion. The only noted gap is missing regression coverage, but that was explicitly deferred by the requester and is not actionable for this PR.
